fusions.name: Stampede Front
fusions.desc: Sends a charging shock of force into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and knocking it back 3 tiles. You heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Drumming Strike
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 6 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Mending Charge
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You leap 3 tiles forward when you use it.

fusions.name: Gallop Dividend
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
